storage: append-only JSONL day-files under <archive>/fdicfailures/, one file per FETCH date with event-identity dedup (cert|fail_date) within and across restarts; gz after 2 days
written_by: server/fdicBanks.ts archiveNewFailures (12h poll of the event-driven source, eager boot)
source: FDIC Bank Data API /banks/failures — keyless JSON. HOST NOTE: api.fdic.gov (the documented banks.data.fdic.gov 301s there — probe finding 2026-07-06). 4,115 failures back to 1934, updated as failures occur (typically announced Friday evenings ET). Fields verified live with an explicit fields= list; FAILDATE arrives M/D/YYYY (normalized to ISO), amounts in $ THOUSANDS, COST (loss to the DIF) null until estimated
license: FDIC public data (US government agency); attribution 'FDIC Bank Data API'

field_map.cert + fail_date — event-identity dedup: FDIC certificate number + ISO failure date; the same failure never re-archives regardless of how many fetch windows include it
field_map.name/city_state/state/charter_class/rest: institution identity as published (RESTYPE distinguishes FAILURE from ASSISTANCE)
field_map.assets_k/deposits_k/cost_k: $ THOUSANDS as published; cost_k is the estimated DIF loss and stays null until the FDIC estimates it — null never becomes zero

confidence_model: RAW official failure events. The regional-bank-stress hypothesis stays gate-locked: gate 1 = cross-check a failure's assets/deposits vs the FDIC press release; gate 2 = failure events vs forward KRE/regional-bank returns. v1 is failures-only; the quarterly per-bank financials snapshot (deposit-flight tracking) is the documented follow-up with its own PR.
cadence: event-driven source (failures as they occur); 12h poll makes quiet stretches dedup no-ops
_note: Universal archive envelope (approved 2026-07-04). BUILD ORDER 6 #3 v1; EDGE DOCTRINE #2 territory (small regional banks — whales can't fish there).
